# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.4

Windows NSSM deployment-orchestrator compatibility hotfix.

This release fixes the guarded deployment script on NSSM installations that
return the configured application path followed by blank or null control
records. The script now selects and sanitizes only the first real value before
comparing it with `C:\RX-Tracker\RX-APP\server.exe`.

The exact production-observed output shape is covered by a PowerShell self-test
in GitHub's database lifecycle CI. No application feature, database migration,
RX Softphone component, production database, or 3.3.1 source was changed.
